question: Siyaram Tewari belongs to which of the following music Gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darbhanga**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siyaram Tewari** belongs to the **Darbhanga Gharana** of Indian classical music.
 
• Darbhanga Gharana is known for its distinctive style of singing Dhrupad, which is one of the oldest forms of North Indian classical music.
 
• The Gharana has a rich history and has contributed significantly to the preservation and propagation of Dhrupad music.
 
• Notable features of Darbhanga Gharana include its emphasis on clarity of notes, intricate rhythmic patterns, and powerful vocal delivery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhrupad** is a major genre of Indian classical vocal music, believed to have originated from the ancient Vedic chants.
 
• The tradition of Dhrupad is maintained through various Gharanas, each with its own unique style and interpretation.
 
• Darbhanga Gharana has produced many renowned musicians and has played a pivotal role in keeping the Dhrupad tradition alive.
 
• Siyaram Tewari is one of the prominent figures associated with this Gharana, known for his mastery and contribution to the art form.
